parsed.rationale: Your team called this an acute STEMI, but I disagree: the tracing shows sinus rhythm at about 65 bpm with normal-width QRS complexes and a normal axis, and the ST segments are isoelectric in every lead, with no reciprocal depression; the upright T waves in V2-V4 look like normal variants, not hyperacute or STEMI changes.
